Nothing says “we value you” quite like layoffs followed by… playing with Legos.

Corporate team building has officially reached its final form: firing half the company, then asking the survivors to process their trauma by building little plastic houses together in a circle.

In this video, we break down the rise of “Lego Serious Play,” the LinkedIn consultants insisting the best time for team building is right after layoffs, and the absolute audacity of companies claiming they can’t afford employees but can afford Lego workshops and
title: LEGOS FOR LAYOFFS - CORPORATE TEAMBUILDING
